Application Data.NAME: SmartChoice Windows & Doors
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: SmartChoice Windows & Doors specializes in the installation and sales of high-quality doors and windows for residential and commercial properties. Our services include custom designs, energy-efficient solutions, and expert installation. We are committed to using materials that comply with all safety regulations, and we do not install window treatments containing lead-based components. Our experienced team ensures that every project is completed with the utmost care and professionalism, making sure to protect the integrity of the client’s property during transit and installation. We also offer maintenance and repair services to ensure the longevity and functionality of our products.

Unique Industry-Related Restriction
• Prohibition on Installation of Lead-Containing Window Treatments: Due to in-
creasing regulatory scrutiny and health concerns, insurers restrict coverage for businesses
installing window treatments containing lead-based paints or components. This restriction
is particularly relevant for firms servicing older buildings or historic properties where such
materials may still be present. The rationale is to avoid liability and cleanup costs associated
with lead exposure, which can result in significant environmental and bodily injury claims.
